items.title: 6 months to live for open models
items.summary: The most serious test to date of open source AI’s viability is happening right now. I’ve seen many waves of anti open-source AI rhetoric come and go since ChatGPT was launched, but none of them had obvious analogues in their potential enforcement to real action already in place targeting the peer, closed models of the day.
